text_simplified: Parents must monitor who their children befriend and spend time with. In this era, a companion has emerged that is no less impactful than a physical friend—namely satellite channels, internet sites, and social media on the devices children carry everywhere. If these are not under parental monitoring and supervision, their danger to minds, religions, and morals is great. How many young men and women have deviated because of them.
